accuracy: A quake record requires the full map of compatible locations and origin ticks. A Braille line requires every aligned character, blank and indicator label. A bridge record requires the forced NS trick count and the complete set of optimal opening cards on every deal.

context_pairs.description: Each pair has identical physical cells after its first cell. One line opens with a numeric indicator, the other with a single capital indicator. Use eight distinct prefixes per final a-j pattern per size. Test both complete lines and both final characters jointly. Score separately from the sampled benchmark and timings.

timing: Median of three synchronized FP32 model forward sweeps over 64 GPU-resident records in batches of eight after a warm-up; excludes encoding, transfers, decoding and scoring.
